name: Buddy Bootcamp
purpose: Train and evaluate Buddy and its MasterBots through measurable, isolated capability development.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.goal: Establish baseline capability and identify missing prerequisites.

levels.name: Guided Practice
levels.goal: Complete supervised exercises with explicit success criteria.

levels.name: Independent Practice
levels.goal: Solve representative tasks without solution leakage.

levels.name: Adversarial Practice
levels.goal: Test robustness against difficult, ambiguous and failure-oriented tasks.

levels.name: Benchmark Preparation
levels.goal: Target the exact capabilities responsible for benchmark gaps.

levels.name: Benchmark Trial
levels.goal: Run held-out evaluation tasks and record evidence.

levels.name: Mastery Verification
levels.goal: Require repeat passes and regression-free evidence before declaring mastery.

levels.name: Maintenance
levels.goal: Periodically retest mastered capabilities and reopen training when regression appears.
